column4: The Anchorage in fleet hands; the act begins here.
The shattered belt where the Corsairs want a home.
A ring of half-built Phantom hulls around Meridian, still guarded.
The Answerer shipyard world; the root of the Automated Fleet Key.
The second Event Horizon Forge, at a black hole's photon ring.
Starless dark at the galaxy's edge; the Listening Array.
